$comment: The layout ratchet's allowlist for the Java generators (ADR-0063). `unconverted`: generator source that still types its own layout; each entry names what it emits and the writer PR that converts it, and is removed when that PR lands (the test fails while a converted file keeps its entry). `exempt`: source that writes text which is not generated code; each says why. Neither list may grow: LayoutRatchetTest compares it with the copy at the branch's merge base.

exempt.codegen-base/src/main/java/com/metaobjec: Builds the text of an exception message with typed line breaks. It is a diagnostic for the person running the build, not code an adopter edits.
Builds the one-paragraph configuration summary used in log output with typed line breaks. It is a diagnostic, not generated code.

Emits the HTML metadata documentation page with its stylesheet. Documentation output is exempt from the writer conversion (ADR-0063; the docs and markdown emitters), because it is not code an adopter edits.
Reads and writes the hash manifest, a line-based data file the tool owns and no adopter edits. It is not generated code.
exempt.codegen-plantuml/src/main/java/com/metao: Emits PlantUML diagram text. A diagram is documentation output, exempt from the writer conversion (ADR-0063), and not code an adopter edits.
